stages.objective: Build and dog-food the source object graph tool used by specialists.

requirements.statement: Inspect ooRexx source and produce an authoritative inventory of files, classes, methods, attributes and requires edges.
acceptanceCriteria: The tool inventories the framework's own source files.
Classes retain their source-file and inheritance relationship.
Methods retain owning class, source file and source line.

requirements.statement: Produce a class hierarchy sketch and machine-readable graph without model inference.
acceptanceCriteria: source_graph.json is generated by the ooRexx tool.
class_hierarchy.txt is generated by the ooRexx tool.

requirements.statement: All framework development tools are dog-fooded before acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: The source graph tool runs over this package's src directory.
The generated graph is checked by an automated test.
